note: Config-driven promotion CATALOG_ONLY -> NATIVE_ONLY -> ON_DEMAND_FUNGIBLE -> FULL_INDEXED. A configured tier is a ceiling; the effective tier is lowered automatically when vetted RPC capability is missing. FULL_INDEXED members are selected from measured RPC health and Transfer log volume (see evidence rpc-measurement.json); no chain is promoted by code change.

selection.criteria: TVL top 25, routable, >=1 eth_getLogs-capable vetted endpoint with probed range >=1000 blocks, <=30 ERC20 Transfer logs per block measured over 20 recent blocks, verified Multicall3; bounded set that passes locally

selected.43114: Avalanche: TVL ~0.64B USD, 2.5 logs/block, probed range 1000
selected.57073: Ink: TVL ~0.21B USD, 0.35 logs/block, probed range 5000, two log endpoints

notSelected.56: no vetted endpoint served unfiltered eth_getLogs

v15.criteria: V1.5 promotion additionally requires two healthy, operationally independent, witness-eligible log operators (provenance inventory) and a live required-witness run with only MATCH windows; release eligibility remains blocked by RPC terms review

promoted.480: World Chain: TVL rank 19 of the bounded set, 17.5 logs/block, Alchemy public + Tenderly gateway (independent operators), 12/12 live windows MATCH, OP-stack safe-tag finality depth 120

v15.notPromoted: All other assessed top-25 routable EVM chains lack two independent witness-eligible log operators, a log-capable endpoint, or exceed the log-volume bound (see tier-a-assessment.json).
